dct_description_sm: California shown as a long labeled island with an indented northern coast.
Jesuit missions around the world are marked.
Mary is shown at top of map surrounded by cherubs. People representing the continents are in each corner.
Shirley, R.W. Mapping the world (4th ed.) 630
